title: How to import custom Python modules in the dbt python model
answer:
As of 2023-08-02, and as noted by hc_dev's comment, there are "workarounds" but you can't reuse dbt python models as if they were traditional python files/packages: https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/build/python-models#code-reuse

The documentation suggests to use declare a UDFs instead or to build your logic and build it as if it was a PyPI Package then import it (but it means that you need to make it available in your backend, i.e. Dataproc, Snowflake..., not simply locally).

But we lack a bit of context to clearly answer your question: What are you trying to do? Do you really want to reuse the same logic twice or do you want to simply "use the output of a given model"? I'm asking because if you simply want to access the output, you can simply use ref like this (as explained in this doc):

upstream_model = dbt.ref("upstream_model_name")
